title: Elaine P
content: Being twenty at the time and three months pregnant, I wasn't allowed to receive any normal post-op drugs. I had two tablets every four hours and in a lot of pain. I went down a a dark helter-skelter tunnel. At the bottom was this beautiful, whiter-than-white space and a feeling of absolute peace. A woman was standing there in a 1940s-style WRAF uniform. She looked a bit like me but wasn't as tall. Her hair was done up in combs in the 1940s style. She told me that "It's not your time yet; you have to go back." So I climbed all the way back up the tunnel, and that's when I started to get better. I described her to my dad, and he said it sounded just like his sister who died in 1945 when she was twenty and three months pregnant. I have never seen a picture of her, and my dad never talked about her. After that, it was amazing how green the grass and the trees were. The birdsong never sounded so lovely. I no longer fear death, although I wouldn't want it to be long and painful.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Surgery-related, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: I don't know. It's like I fell asleep.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, There was no sense of time, or life, or the people I had left. It just was.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Apart from my aunt speaking, it was quiet.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, A helter-skelter is like a tunnel, but not.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, An aunt I had never met.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, It's a brightness you can't describe.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place, Just a brilliantly white space.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt no longer in conflict with nature
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Catholic, After my experience, my faith came to me. I finally had something to believe in.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I believed in nothing after the experience that changed. I still don’t believe in God as a being, but he was there in that feeling of peace and love. The Catholic Church seems to come closest to what I felt.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, Before, I was coasting through life. It taught me to appreciate it a bit more.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, Definitely female in a 1940s WRAF uniform.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, This earthly experience is not all there is. There is better to come.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, The fact that my aunt, who died many years before, was talking to me.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: While I appreciate what I have now, I’m also ready for what is to come.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, Nearly 40 years later, I can still remember accurately everything about what I saw and felt. I don’t remember the operation to take my appendix out, which was only 48 hours before, and what happened leading up to being stabbed is fuzzy.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The fact that I look like my aunt, a fact I never knew.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was too vivid not to be real.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, It’s still too vivid not to be real.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I wrote it as it was.
